direct.title: Get straight to the point
direct.text: For a faster fix, describe the issue clearly and include details: mode, nickname, time, and so on.

bugs.title: Bugs and errors
bugs.text: Describe what happened and what you expected to see. Attach screenshots or video if you have them.

balance.title: Balance and modes
balance.text: Tell us which mode or balance detail feels unfair and what could be improved.

rating.question: How does the rating system work?
rating.answer: Rating changes after completed matches and depends on the mode, result, and opponent strength.

disconnect.question: What should I do if I disconnect from a match?
disconnect.answer: Include the mode, approximate time, nickname, and a match link if you have one. This helps us find the session faster.

report.question: How do I report a rule breaker?
report.answer: Create a request with the "Other" or "Balance" category and attach a match link or screenshot.

progress.question: How can I restore lost progress?
progress.answer: Send your nickname, account email, and describe which action happened before the progress disappeared.

chat.question: Are there chat restrictions?
chat.answer: Yes. Insults, spam, and attempts to bypass the rules can lead to account restrictions.

hero.title: How can we
hero.description: Your request will be saved in the project database and sent to the admin support section. Choose where you would like to continue the conversation: by email or in the Telegram bot.

status.text: Our support team tries to reply as quickly as possible

form.title: Create a request
form.emailDescription: The reply will arrive in your inbox. We will continue the conversation there
form.telegramDescription: We will redirect you to the Telegram bot, where you can continue the conversation.
form.messagePlaceholder: Describe the situation in as much detail as possible... What happened? Where? When?
form.consent: I confirm that I have read the project rules and consent to the processing of my data.

validation.name: Enter your name so support knows how to address you.
validation.email: Enter a valid email address for the reply.
validation.message: The message must be at least 10 characters long.

success.telegram: Thank you! Now open Telegram to continue the conversation with support.
success.email: Thank you! Your message has been sent. We will reply by email.
success.telegramHint: If Telegram did not open automatically, press the button above.
